newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 78 bln lire of Italy 18-mo Ctz.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 78 bln lire of Italy 18-mo Ctz.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 78 billion lire of 18-month zero-coupon certificates (Ctz) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
For 24-month Ctzs specialists bid for 301 billion against 250 billion offered and assigned.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 6.61 trillion lire at the open auction for the October 15 1998 paper, against 2.00 trillion worth of certificates on offer. The auction price was set at 91.45 from 90.85 previously.
The Treasury also received bids for 6.788 trillion lire of new two-year May 14, 1999 Ctzs against 2.50 trillion on offer. The auction price was set at 88.15.
